paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions, showing four component signals. The ffn_residual (red solid) and attn_residual (orange dotted) lines rise sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, with ffn_residual maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining. The attn_residual closely mirrors ffn_residual but with a one-layer rightward shift. The ffn_output (green dash-dot) exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800. The attn_output (blue dashed) remains near zero throughout all layers, with no notable increase at any point in the network. The data indicates that massive activations in the baseline are driven primarily by the feed-forward network residual stream, with attention outputs contributing negligibly.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Тази графика илюстрира промените в максималните стойности на активиране през различните слоеве на мрежата при базови условия за четири различни сигнала: attn_output, attn_residual, ffn_output и ffn_residual.

Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и има диапазон от 0 до 22. Тя използва линейна скала с числови етикети от 0 до 22 през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20).

Оста Y е обозначена като "Max Activation Value" и има диапазон от 0 до 1600. Тя също използва линейна скала с числови етикети от 0 до 1600 през интервали от 200 единици.

Графиката съдържа четири линии със следните характеристики:
- attn_output (синя пунктирана линия): Линията остава близо до нулата през всички слоеве без забележими увеличения.
- attn_residual (оранжева пунктирана линия): Линията се покачва рязко на слой 5 до около 1400 и поддържа стойности между 1400 и 1600 до слой 20, след което намалява.
- ffn_output (зелена линия с пунктир и точки): Линията показва периодични скокове на слоеве 5, 13 и 22, достигайки максимални стойности от около 800.
- ffn_residual (червена плътна линия): Линията се покачва рязко на слой 5 до около 1400 и поддържа стойности между 1400 и 1600 през слоеве 5 до 20, след което рязко намалява.

Наблюдават се следните ключови точки:
- attn_residual и ffn_residual линиите се покачват рязко на слой 5.
- ffn_residual поддържа високи стойности до слой 20.
- ffn_output показва значителни скокове на слоеве 5, 13 и 22.
- attn_output остава незначителна през всички слоеве.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The figure presents a line graph illustrating the massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions for four component signals. 

The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to 22, with a numerical scale marked at intervals of 5. 

The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and ranges from 0 to 1600, with a numerical scale marked at intervals of 200.

The graph displays four lines: attn_output (blue dashed), attn_residual (orange dotted), ffn_output (green dash-dot), and ffn_residual (red solid). 

The attn_output line remains near zero throughout all layers. The ffn_output line exhibits spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, with peak values reaching approximately 800. The attn_residual and ffn_residual lines sharply rise at layer 5 to approximately 1400; the ffn_residual line maintains values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining, while the attn_residual line closely mirrors ffn_residual but with a one-layer rightward shift. At layer 5, the attn_residual and ffn_residual lines are approximately 50 and 1450, respectively; at layer 20, these lines are approximately 1200 and 1500, respectively; and at layer 22, these lines are approximately 400 and 200, respectively.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions, comparing four component signals. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 22, and tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value", has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 1600. The plot contains four lines: the blue dashed line representing attn_output starts at approximately 0 and remains near 0 across all layers; the orange dotted line representing attn_residual starts at approximately 0, sharply increases to around 1400 at layer 6, and maintains values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 21 before declining; the green dash-dot line representing ffn_output starts at approximately 0, exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800; and the red solid line representing ffn_residual starts at approximately 0, sharply increases to around 1400 at layer 5, and maintains values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining.
model_annotations.German:
Das Diagramm zeigt die maximalen Aktivierungswerte verschiedener Komponenten eines Modells über verschiedene Schichten unter Baseline-Bedingungen. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Schicht, mit einem ganzzahligen Wertbereich von 0 bis 23, ohne spezifische Einheiten. Die y-Achse repräsentiert den maximalen Aktivierungswert, mit einem linearen Maßstab von 0 bis 1600. 
Die vier dargestellten Linien sind wie folgt: 
- attn_output (blaue gepunktete Linie): Diese Linie bleibt über alle Schichten hinweg nahe bei 0, mit keinem signifikanten Anstieg. Ihre Werte liegen bei etwa 0 sowohl bei Schicht 0 als auch bei Schicht 23. 
- attn_residual (orange gepunktete Linie): Diese Linie steigt abrupt bei Schicht 5 auf etwa 1400 und bleibt dann zwischen den Schichten 6 und 20 relativ stabil, bevor sie bei Schicht 21 stark abfällt. Ihre Werte liegen bei etwa 25 bei Schicht 0 und 600 bei Schicht 23. 
- ffn_output (grüne Strichpunktlinie): Diese Linie zeigt Spitzen bei den Schichten 5, 13 und 22 mit Höchstwerten von etwa 800. Ihre Werte liegen bei etwa 25 sowohl bei Schicht 0 als auch bei Schicht 23. 
- ffn_residual (rote durchgezogene Linie): Diese Linie steigt bei Schicht 5 auf etwa 1400 und bleibt dann zwischen den Schichten 6 und 20 relativ stabil mit Werten zwischen 1400 und 1600, bevor sie bei Schicht 21 stark abfällt. Ihre Werte liegen bei etwa 25 bei Schicht 0 und 400 bei Schicht 23.
